summary: Add a retirement closure ledger to UBU-Q0163 that indexes every UBU-D0318 evidence requirement to its covering bounded slice or existing assertion source, names the record that closes each row, records that every row is currently unfiled/no-result/outstanding, and states the closure condition (all rows passing at the confirmed deployed revision, operator inventory and approval attached, identified workaround retired; manifest-retained residual blockers are a permitted end state). The Resolution paragraph is rewritten to point at the ledger and to restrict further specification to recorded failing results. No new gates, slices, ids or metadata changes.
rationale: The question's own Resolution already states that every UBU-D0318 evidence bullet maps to a bounded slice and that specification should be added only where an implementation result exposes a gap. No implementation result exists, so the next useful committee contribution is not another slice but a compact closure index that stops accretion and makes closure mechanical: one row per UBU-D0318 requirement, its covering slice/assertion source, the exact record needed, and current status. The ledger also makes explicit what the existing text implies but never states in one place: the question closes only on revision-pinned passing results at the deployed revision plus the operator's inventory and approved handoff, that residual blockers deliberately retained by the manifest for uncovered scope do not keep the question open, and that a failing result must be recorded before any further specification. No new decision is added because UBU-D0318 already fixes the closure requirements; the ledger operationalizes them without changing policy, and the question remains Open with Human approval required.
patch:
diff --git a/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md b/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md
--- a/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md
+++ b/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md
@@ -3900,7 +3900,25 @@
 Attach implementation revision, exact commands, raw-wire fixture digests with time-library/tzdata pins, request parameters and page chains, backend/configuration identities, diagnostic outcomes, Task/version lineage, manifest certification results and probe outcomes to the filed ticket and scoped manifest. Passing this slice covers only the exercised zone, transition and input kinds; the operator's actual source zones and the remaining `UBU-D0318` gates still require evidence and approval. No filing or passing result is recorded here.
 
+### Retirement closure ledger
+
+This ledger indexes each `UBU-D0318` evidence requirement to its covering slice or assertion source above and to the record that closes it. It adds no gate, check or slice. Update it only with a filed ticket reference, a revision-pinned result or an operator record; a committee pass with nothing to record leaves this block unchanged. Record a failing result in its row with the implementation revision, exact command and observed-versus-required outcome before adding any specification, and limit that specification to the exposed gap.
+
+| `UBU-D0318` requirement | Covering slice or assertion source | Closure record | Recorded status |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| One Task lineage per occurrence across repeat/on-demand capture, retry and restart; distinct occurrences stay distinct | Cancellation slice capture/reopen row; timezone slice capture/reopen row; `tests/calendar_occupancy.rs` repeat-capture assertions | Passing revision-pinned results for both rows and execution of the existing assertions at the same revision | Not executed at a pinned revision |
+| Single-occurrence moves and explicit exceptions supersede the prior reservation without rewriting logged history | `tests/calendar_occupancy.rs` move assertions; Google read-path sparse-evidence binding after a move | Executed move assertions at the pinned revision with occupied/free interval results on the CPU path and each enabled backend | Not executed at a pinned revision |
+| Explicit occurrence cancellation removes stale future occupancy; omission, truncation, out-of-horizon reads and diagnostics admit none | Cancellation remediation ticket with its payload-minimization/replay extension; Google read-path qualification; every bounded cancellation slice row | Filed ticket id, implementation revision and passing results for every cancellation row, including the crash/replay, purge, sparse-page and any cursor rows | Ticket unfiled; no result |
+| Series edits used by the reviewed scope remove stale future occupancy | Series-truncation follow-up | Filed ticket id, qualified read path and passing results for the truncation reproduction and its controls; a different series-edit kind used by the reviewed scope needs its own bounded slice before this row passes for it | Ticket unfiled; no result |
+| Timezone/DST and horizon-crossing occupancy, explicit unsupported-input outcomes, uncertifiable incomplete capture and repeated checks after horizon advancement | Timezone, horizon-crossing and unsupported-input slice | Filed ticket id, time-library/tzdata pins and passing results for every row and probe | Ticket unfiled; no result |
+| CPU reference path and each enabled backend agree on busy/free capacity, reject flexible placement inside fixed commitments, count no reservation twice and keep genuine overlaps as conflicts | Mixed-blocker slice capacity-input and genuine-overlap assertions; the probe sets of every slice | Per-backend/configuration probe and multiplicity results attached to each slice's ticket | No result |
+| Mixed covered/uncovered blocker: residual protection, approved, interrupted and stale-version handoff, restart and replay | Mixed-blocker handoff ticket | Filed ticket id, implementation revision and passing results for every handoff row and probe | Ticket unfiled; no result |
+| Operator source/series inventory and deployed path/revision confirmation | Operator record; no slice supplies it | Policy-safe inventory of the sources, series and planning scope the workaround covers, blocker references, the deployed `ubu-orchestrator` revision and backend/configuration identity, and confirmation that the audited paths are the deployed paths | Outstanding |
+| Scoped coverage manifest and operator-approved handoff | `UBU-D0318` manifest and approval binding | Manifest digest, exact replacements and residual intervals, approval bound to the manifest and current versions, batch admission outcome and certified recalculation | Outstanding |
+
+The question closes only when every row records a passing result at the confirmed deployed revision, the operator records are attached, and the identified workaround Static event is retired through the approved handoff. Residual blockers that the manifest explicitly retains for unsupported or uncovered scope are a permitted end state, not the retired workaround. Record the approved handoff and its evidence as a decision; `UBU-D0318` and that decision then resolve this question. A changed deployed revision, source scope or planning horizon returns the affected rows to unverified until the affected checks are rerun. Ledger entries obey current Compartment policy: attach digests and policy-safe identifiers, never operator calendar content.
+
 ### Resolution
 
-Open. `UBU-D0318` remains the retirement specification. The source audits, proposed cancellation remediation ticket with its payload-minimization/replay extension, Google read-path qualification, bounded cancellation slice, separate series-truncation follow-up, mixed-blocker handoff ticket and timezone/horizon-crossing/unsupported-input slice identify implementation work and required evidence; none supplies passing results. Every `UBU-D0318` evidence bullet now maps to at least one bounded slice or existing assertion source above; add specification only where an implementation result exposes a gap. Filing and implementing the repair, qualified cancellation delivery/ordering and any cursor recovery, actual scoped source/series coverage, confirmation of deployed paths/revisions, the remaining required checks and the operator-approved blocker handoff remain outstanding. This documentation change removes no blocker.
+Open. `UBU-D0318` remains the retirement specification and the retirement closure ledger above is its closure index: every `UBU-D0318` evidence bullet maps to a ledger row with a covering slice or assertion source, and no row records a filed ticket, passing result or operator record. The source audits, proposed cancellation remediation ticket with its payload-minimization/replay extension, Google read-path qualification, bounded cancellation slice, separate series-truncation follow-up, mixed-blocker handoff ticket and timezone/horizon-crossing/unsupported-input slice identify implementation work and required evidence; none supplies passing results. Add specification only where a recorded failing result exposes a gap. Filing and implementing the repair, qualified cancellation delivery/ordering and any cursor recovery, actual scoped source/series coverage, confirmation of deployed paths/revisions, the remaining required checks and the operator-approved blocker handoff remain outstanding. This documentation change removes no blocker.

commit_message:
UMC: docs: add retirement closure ledger for UBU-Q0163

Index every UBU-D0318 evidence requirement to its covering bounded slice
or assertion source, the record that closes it and its current unfiled
status; state the closure condition and restrict further specification to
recorded failing results. No gates, ids or metadata change.
validation_notes: No shell or file-read tool was available in this session, so `git apply --check` was not executed; the patch was composed from the verbatim working-tree excerpt of the UBU-Q0163 block supplied with the request.

Hunk counts were hand-verified: 7 old lines (6 context + 1 removed) and 25 new lines (6 context + 19 added). The start line is an estimate; `git apply` locates the hunk by its unique context, namely the timezone slice's final paragraph followed by the Q0163 `### Resolution` heading and paragraph, so no other question's Resolution section can match.

Only the Q0163 `### Resolution` paragraph is removed and re-added; the single-line metadata line, headings, tables and every other section are untouched. Status remains Open and no metadata field changes.
No question or decision ids are allocated; the cited decisions remain `UBU-D0318`, `UBU-D0258` and `UBU-D0259`.
The added prose deliberately avoids the literal tokens `Status:` and `Resolved by:` so single-line metadata parsing of the block is unaffected.

If the working tree differs from the excerpt (for example trailing whitespace on a context line), regenerate the hunk from the current block: the intended edit is insertion of the `### Retirement closure ledger` section immediately before `### Resolution` and replacement of that paragraph with the new text.
